products.description: Infusion de Rhubarbe Eau de Parfum captures the playful personality of rhubarb in an unexpected floral fruity fragrance, pink and green, sweet and acidulous. A vegetable by definition, yet renowned for its fruity tones, rhubarb challenges our expectations, settling upon a facet of our personality that is both effervescent and irreverent. Infused within Prada´s “Esprit d’Infusion”, rhubarb represents the quintessential contradiction at the heart of Prada, being incisively fresh yet subtle, delicate yet addictive. The pink-tinted hue of the fragrance appears in a luxurious bottle with an iconic Saffiano leather cap in a bright shade of pink: a playful nod to the star ingredient within.

products.description: Prada Infusion de Santal Chai is a luminous woody fragrance that blends creamy sandalwood with the spicy warmth of a chai latte accord. Bright citrus and cardamom add a fresh, unexpected twist, while comforting musks bring a clean, intimate finish. Sophisticated sandalwood reveals its milky, velvety facets, harmonizing with the gourmand allure of chai spices. Cardamom introduces an addictive vibration, and citrus notes illuminate the composition, creating a scent that feels both cozy and radiant. Infusion de Santal Chai is an invitation to experience creamy comfort and sparkling freshness in perfect balance.

products.title: Luna Rossa Ocean EDT 50 ml
products.description: Formulated by IFF Master Perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaim, Prada Luna Rossa Ocean has a unique neo-fresh olfactory signature that reinvents the emblematic fougère family. Sublimating notes of aromatic freshness mixed with the sophisticated sensuality of bergamot, a contrast is created with the sophisticated essence of vetiver. Everything intertwines in the heart notes with an elegant iris accord. The fragrance unveils a luminous cocktail of citrus combined with a lively duo of lavender and sage to add a fresh, clean sensation. The unique leather heart creates a second skin effect, exploring a sensual accord of suede and saffron combined with the elegant creamy notes of iris root. Enveloped in a masterful blend of patchouli, Haitian vetiver and musks, the fragrance leaves an addictive and masculine scent.

products.title: Paradigme Le Parfum 50 ml
products.description: Prada Paradigme Le Parfum redefines masculine intensity with a sophisticated and enveloping amber-woody signature. The opening reveals the sensuality of amber woods such as Peru balsam, benzoin and guaiac resin enhanced by Amberever®, a new generation molecule that amplifies diffusion and persistence. In the heart, elegant and profound leather-vanilla embraces gourmand geranium with rose nuances. A distinctive lingering trail lasting up to 12 hours invites exploring new perspectives and naturally expressing contemporary and conscious elegance.
